description: This file defines the CustomerService class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, providing methods to interact with Customer data, such as searching customers, counting them, and retrieving specific customer details via the CustomerDao.

classes.name: CustomerService
classes.description: Service class for managing Customer entities, providing methods to search, count, and retrieve customers by ID.

methods.name: getCustomerDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the CustomerDao instance used for data access.

methods.name: setCustomerDao
methods.description: Sets the CustomerDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Searches for customers based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getCustomersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of customers matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Customer entity by its ID.
